The content of the news text mentions that the photographer took the photograph when Tony Blair visited the family in South Cleveland hospital while their daughter was there for medical reasons. Because the photo was taken during a medical emergency, and this fact is omitted from the News Caption, I am marking the News Caption as out of context (OOC=True).
